recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆嗜中性球核分成約 7 葉（分葉過多，hypersegmentation），周圍紅血球大小不一並有許多大卵圓形紅血球（macro-ovalocytes），加上淚滴狀紅血球，是巨母細胞性貧血的典型周邊血表現。
features: Neutrophil with about 7 nuclear lobes (hypersegmentation; >=6 lobes is diagnostic, >5% with 5 lobes suggestive)
Marked anisocytosis with numerous oval macrocytes (macro-ovalocytes)
Some red cells contain small dark inclusions, possibly Howell-Jolly bodies or basophilic material
Platelets small and clumped; photograph has a yellow-green color cast limiting color assessment
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with prominent oval macrocytes and occasional teardrop cells. A neutrophil with approximately seven nuclear lobes is present. Several red cells contain small dark inclusions consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies, although the color cast of the photograph limits characterization. Platelets are present in small clumps. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia (vitamin B12 or folate deficiency).

ddx.vs: MDS more often shows hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) and hypogranular neutrophils, and macrocytes are usually round rather than oval, with normal B12/folate levels.
Morphology can be identical; medication history and normal vitamin levels distinguish it.
These produce round macrocytes and target cells without hypersegmented neutrophils.
